title: Nine-level sloped-site Group C residential building alternative solution (Council Order 0015441)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The case concerns a non-combustible Group C building on a sloped site, described as six storeys above grade at the front and three partially below grade; the south and east sides face a ravine.

The proposed alternative applied the up-to-six-storey provisions of Article 3.2.2.43 to a nine-level building otherwise assessed under Article 3.2.2.42, using four-hour compartmentation and separate stair-pressurization measures.
The appeal record listed an alternative-solution report, 145 architectural drawing sheets plus appendix drawings, and two engineering letters.

limitations: Only the Council order was retrieved; the actual alternative-solution report, drawings and engineering letters are named in its record but not attached.
